inputs.value: Fully outpaint the image with no empty areas, no black or white borders, and no unfilled regions. Seamlessly extend the scene, strictly continuing all background elements, lighting, colors, textures, and perspective so the new parts blend perfectly with the original frame. Preserve the style, mood, and main subjects exactly, avoiding any new characters, text, or unrelated objects. Pay special attention to edges, patterns, and structural continuity, ensuring the outpainted regions naturally align with existing geometry. The final result must look like a fully complete and harmonious image, with every pixel convincingly rendered and integrated into the scene.
